extracted.intended_audience: USPTO patent examiners; patent attorneys, agents, and applicants
extracted.subtask_description: The USPTO Manual of Patent Examining Procedure (MPEP) — a comprehensive, chaptered set of formal guidance and standards governing U.S. patent prosecution, examination, appeals, patentability, post‑grant proceedings, and related procedures. This page is an index/listing of the MPEP chapters, appendices, and supporting materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 0100 - Secrecy, Access, National Security, and Foreign Filing
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter addressing secrecy orders, access to patent information, national security considerations, and rules for foreign filing of patent applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 0200 - Types, Cross-Noting, and Status of Application
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter covering application types, cross‑noting between related applications, and application status issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 0300 - Ownership and Assignment
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter describing rules and procedures regarding ownership of patent rights and assignments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 0400 - Representative of Inventor or Owner
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter on who may represent an inventor or owner before the USPTO, practitioner duties, and representation rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 0500 - Receipt and Handling of Mail and Papers
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter covering receipt, routing, and handling of correspondence, submissions, and papers filed with the USPTO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 0600 - Parts, Form, and Content of Application
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter describing the required parts of a patent application, form requirements, and content standards for specification, claims, drawings, and abstracts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 0700 - Examination of Applications
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter detailing the substantive and procedural aspects of patent examination, including examination practice, office actions, and allowance/denial procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 0800 - Restriction in Applications Filed Under 35 U.S.C. 111; Double Patenting
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter discussing restriction requirements, election of species, and double patenting issues under 35 U.S.C. 111.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 0900 - Prior Art, Classification, and Search
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter on prior art principles, patent classification, and procedures for conducting prior art searches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 1000 - Matters Decided by Various U.S. Patent and Trademark Office Officials
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter summarizing which matters are decided by different USPTO officials and the applicable procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 1100 - Statutory Invention Registration (SIR) and Pre-Grant Publication (PG Pub)
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter covering statutory invention registrations and pre‑grant publication of patent applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 1200 - Appeal
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter describing appeals from examiner decisions, appeal practice before the Patent Trial and Appeal Board (PTAB), and related procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 1300 - Allowance and Issue
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter on procedures and requirements for allowance, payment of issue fees, and issuance of patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 1400 - Correction of Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter addressing correction mechanisms for patents (e.g., reissue, certificate of correction) and related procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 1500 - Design Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter covering prosecution, examination, and statutory requirements specific to design patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 1600 - Plant Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter on requirements and procedures specific to plant patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 1700 - Miscellaneous
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter containing miscellaneous topics relating to patent practice not covered elsewhere.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 1800 - Patent Cooperation Treaty
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter describing PCT procedures, international filings, and the USPTO's role under the PCT framework.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 1900 - Protest
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter on protest procedures (third‑party submissions and challenges) and how protests are handled by the USPTO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 2000 - Duty of Disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter detailing the duty of disclosure, candor, and good faith requirements (e.g., duty to disclose known relevant prior art to the USPTO).

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 2100 - Patentability
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter covering substantive patentability requirements (novelty, non‑obviousness, statutory subject matter, utility, written description, enablement, and claim issues).

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 2200 - Citation of Prior Art and Ex Parte Reexamination of Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter on citation procedures for prior art and the process for ex parte reexamination of patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 2300 - Interference Proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter covering interference proceedings to determine priority of invention (historical and procedural guidance).

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 2400 - Biotechnology
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter addressing biotechnology‑specific issues in patent examination and patentability analysis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 2500 - Maintenance Fees
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter covering payment and requirements for maintenance fees to keep patents in force.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 2600 - Optional Inter Partes Reexamination
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter on optional inter partes reexamination proceedings and their procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 2700 - Patent Terms and Extensions
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter describing patent term calculations, extensions, and adjustments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix I - Partial List of Trademarks
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix providing a partial list of trademarks referenced in the MPEP.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix II - List of Decisions Cited
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix listing judicial and board decisions cited in the MPEP.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix L - Patent Laws
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix containing consolidated patent statutes relevant to the MPEP and patent practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix R - Patent Rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix containing consolidated patent rules (CFR/USPTO rules) relevant to MPEP procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix T - Patent Cooperation Treaty
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix materials related to the Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT).

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix AI - Administrative Instructions Under the PCT
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix containing administrative instructions under the Patent Cooperation Treaty.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix P - Paris Convention
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix containing materials related to the Paris Convention for the Protection of Industrial Property.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subject Matter Index
rubrics_metrics.description: Index of subjects covered throughout the MPEP for locating topical guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form Paragraphs
rubrics_metrics.description: Collection of form paragraph texts used in office actions and correspondence to standardize examiner communications.
